bench_io_readers_gz.title: IO readers (gzipped paths)
bench_io_readers_gz.description: Gzip-aware reader paths (parallel-gzip + zlib fallback) on the .fastq.gz real-data cell. Asserts pgzip beats single-thread zlib by ≥ 25%.

bench_io_readers_plain.title: IO readers (plain / async / mmap)
bench_io_readers_plain.description: Plain (non-gz) reader paths. POSIX read / mmap / async-pipeline + kseqpp + naive_ifstream baselines, on synthetic plus real-data corpora.

bench_io_writers.title: IO writers (sync / parallel)
bench_io_writers.description: Writer paths. sync vs parallel4 vs parallel8 bioseq writers + naive_ofstream baseline. Each iteration writes the corpus, measures, and validates the roundtrip read records the same count.
